subject: Private hosting readiness + schedule for VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fastcare.health>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting readiness + schedule for VPC architecture review

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can keep momentum:

What we heard on the call:
- You need a VPC/private deployment behind your AWS account for PHI workloads; expected initial throughput ~50 req/s and spikes to 200 req/s.
- Data residency to stay in us-west-2, plus SOC 2 and encryption-in-transit at TLS1.3 are critical.
- You want the ops team (network + security) in the next call to validate firewall/NAT/peering patterns.

Proposed next meeting: Private/VPC architecture deep-dive (technical). Goals: confirm network topology, required IAM policies, and handoff checklist for the pilot.

Suggested 60-minute slots (PT):
- Tue Mar 17 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Mar 18 — 15:00–16:00 PT
- Thu Mar 19 — 08:00–09:00 PT

Please reply with the best slot or propose two alternatives. If you can, include the security contact and a primary AWS account ID for pre-call environment checks.

I've attached a short pre-call runbook and a network checklist that outline the information we'd like ahead of the call (network ranges, S3 access pattern, expected egress). That will let Mina (SE) prep targeted network diagrams.

Attachments: pre-call-runbook.pdf, network-checklist.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/fastcare-health

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

---
Note: internal follow-up items for Marissa & Mina: 1) Mina to draft a one-page ops checklist; 2) Marissa to prepare contract-level notes on data residency options for the pilot.
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fastcare.health>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@fastcare.health>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private hosting readiness + schedule for VPC architecture review

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear recap and the materials. Both look useful.

We can take Wed Mar 18 15:00–16:00 PT. Please include our security lead, Samir Khan (cc'd). He'll want to verify the network checklist and confirm whether we need a dedicated NAT or can reuse existing transit setup.

A couple of asks before the call:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood needs cross-account IAM roles or if we'll create roles in our account and share ARNs?
- We will share an AWS account ID by Monday for pre-checks.

I reviewed the runbook briefly — looks good. We'll also have someone from procurement join if there are contract/SLAs to flag during scheduling.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Morgan | Head of Platform Engineering, FastCare Health
alex.morgan@fastcare.health | +1 (206) 555-0199

Alex / Priyom —

Wed Mar 18 15:00 PT works for me. I'll own the technical agenda. Planning notes:

Proposed 60-min agenda (technical deep-dive):
- 5m: Introductions & objectives (Priyom)
- 15m: FastCare current network topology + security constraints (FastCare)
- 20m: Redwood proposed VPC pattern (transit vs dedicated), NAT/Egress plan, and IAM role model (Mina)
- 15m: Pilot checklist and next steps (open items: routing, S3 access, KMS key usage)
- 5m: Action items and ownership

Pre-call ask: please send the primary AWS account ID and a short list of expected attendees by EOD Mon so I can generate a draft topology and bring a sample CloudFormation snippet to speed decisions.

I've placed a tentative calendar placeholder here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=priv-vpc-arch-review — I'll formally send the invite once Alex confirms attendees.

I'll also review the network-checklist and mark any items that need clarification.

—Mina
Mina Haddad | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
